cues.zh: iPhone 是多年创新的成果。
cues.en: The iPhone is the result of years of innovation.

cues.zh: 考虑产品在其生命周期的
cues.en: considering what happens to a product
at every stage of its life cycle.

cues.zh: 时机一到，Liam 就会拆解你的 iPhone。
cues.en: When it's time, Liam deconstructs your iPhone.

cues.zh: 这样零件内的材料就能被再利用；
cues.en: so the materials inside those parts can be repurposed;
to rescue cobalt and lithium from the battery,

cues.zh: 分离摄像头中的金和铜，
cues.en: separate the gold and copper in the camera,
extract silver and platinum from the main logic board,

cues.zh: 让你的 iPhone 中的材料得以延续。
cues.en: so the materials in your iPhone can live on.

cues.zh: 因为在资源有限的世界里，
cues.en: Because in a world with limited resources,
